fields.Name: Sales: Party Lookup Promotable Accounts
fields.UserQuestion: Which organizations could be added as sales accounts?
fields.Description: Search for the promote dialog: organizations that do NOT yet have a sales account row, whose name, legal name, acronym or website domain starts with the term.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Organization WITHOUT a SalesAccount row -- the exact complement of 'Sales: Party Lookup Accounts', differing only in EXISTS vs NOT EXISTS. Party lookup contract (bc-aidp-next-golive#372): columns ID, Name, Detail (Acronym and WebsiteDomain joined by ' · ', whichever are set); parameters Term (required) and Domain (optional; matched against Organization.WebsiteDomain). Prefix LIKE on indexed base columns (Name, LegalName, Acronym, WebsiteDomain), TOP 20 ordered by Name, no view and no count. Read by the sales-owned promote dialog, NOT by bizapps-party-field: that control cannot mark a row unselectable, so a promotable organization must never reach the deal's account picker (PL1/PL3).
